text:
If you caught today's sunshine, you got the better half of the weekend — clouds have already rolled back in behind that mid-80s high, and tonight settles in easy: partly cloudy, a low near 64, with winds going light and swinging out of the west then south. Nothing to complain about for a porch sit after that 8:07 sunset, though the lake's calm too, winds under 10 knots and waves a foot or less if anyone's still out there.

Monday's the one to plan around. The front the forecasters have been watching all week finally arrives, and models agree showers and thunderstorms move in by afternoon, likely with a wetter push than a typical summer pop-up — rain odds sit at 70%. There's a real spread on just how warm it gets first, anywhere from upper 70s to mid 80s, so I'd call it a warm, humid morning before storms take the temperature down. Get outdoor plans done before midday; by afternoon the lake winds ramp toward 25 knots and it turns into an indoor kind of evening.
